{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ornki''' were the inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orn Kios/Legends|Orn Kios]]. They lived by [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] and lived in homes of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] and canvas supported by huge lilypads. The Ornki resented the fact that offworlders often came to Orn Kios as tourists.<ref name="EA ">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
